title: Concept: Overly open CORS (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, corss*(s*)|origins*:s*['"]* lets foreign origins read responses. Wildcard origins combine dangerously with credentialed requests. The remedy is an explicit origin list (an explicit origin list).
applicability: javascript API servers and middleware; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Cross-origin data theft where credentials apply; MEDIUM severity.
